speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Transport whether the Ministry will consider making it mandatory for all bicycles and PMDs to be fitted with laser lights which project a symbol of a bicycle or PMD on to the path five metres ahead, to warn pedestrians that there is a cyclist or PMD approaching them.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: If the rider of the PMD is unable to fix such lights onto the device, the requisite lights would have to be worn by the person.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: But I am just wondering whether we could start this with the delivery riders.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Because at night, the bulk of the PMDs on our paths are the delivery riders when there is an increase in the number of food orders.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: A lot of the issues are with the delivery riders.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, maybe, we can start with them, where the food delivery companies will bear some of the cost of installing these laser lights.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I understand the white light as well, but that can only be seen when you are facing the PMD.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: What I am suggesting is the laser light, which means that even if the PMD is behind you, you can actually see your path in front of you that there is a PMD about to approach.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I actually experienced this in London, where it was very useful.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: All the time, I could see that there was going to be a bicycle that was approaching me and I can then take whatever necessary action to make sure that I do not get hit.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: Just to share with Mr Louis Ng, we did look at the initiatives that were implemented in London.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: We understand that the key benefit of the laser projection light is to aid on road cyclists, in their interactions with other motor vehicles that may have blind spots.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: In the context of Singapore, there are key considerations that we have to look into.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: Bear in mind that what was done in London was actually on roads shared with motor vehicles.
